title: Herbed Fish Bowl
description: A Thai-inspired dish featuring fish cooked in a flavorful herb sauce served in a bowl.
instructions: Season the fish fillets with salt, pepper, and chili flakes.
Heat 1 tbsp of oil in an oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat.
Sear the fish for 2-3 minutes on each side.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 8-10 minutes or until cooked through.
While the fish is cooking, prepare the herb sauce by blending the basil, mint, cilantro, ginger, and garlic in a blender.
Add the herbed sauce to the skillet with the fish and stir to combine.
Squeeze the lime juice over the fish and herbs.
Serve the fish in a bowl with the herb sauce spooned over the top.
Garnish with additional herbs and a sprinkle of chili flakes if desired.
